risksForTheParent: The shared library ships whole, so U17 carries 14 lines (sha256 and lastLine) whose only consumer is the staged U17b closure. Trimming them would make U17b's restore a three-file change instead of a two-file one.
U13's preserve-run-logs module still has no caller in the repository until U17b lands; the parent keeps running its CLI by hand before each worktree removal.
The closure and the main proof were written, gated and mutant-tested in this lane before the split (21/21) but are NOT proven on the head U17 ships; U17b must re-take every gate on its own baseline.

The pin copies the 17 MB ledger directory into a temporary directory under openspec/planning/ so that validate-roadmap.mjs resolves the real repository root three levels up; it removes it afterwards, and a crashed run would leave it behind.

v3's admission-receipt behaviour (leave the file alone, record parentDecisionRecordedHere on the unit entry) means the fold's admission entry has one key more than U14's; the pin asserts that exact difference rather than hiding it.
